design.purpose: Make a decorative six-pointed snowflake for one window, from one square sheet.

steps.c: Place the square paper flat on the table.
Fold the top-right corner onto the bottom-left corner.
Fold the top-left corner onto the bottom-right corner.
Fold the top-right edge through the top point.
Fold the top-left edge through the top point.
Cut straight across the wide end of the wedge.
Cut a small triangle from each long edge.
Cut a small triangle from the pointed tip.
Open the sheet out flat to reveal the snowflake.
